crime: Whenever a simple decision left {WITCH_NAME} frozen, another girl chose between the options for her. {WITCH_NAME} was spared the choice, while the girl enjoyed arranging their time together and having her company. At midday, a prison group chat asked who would join a pool game and who would read in the library. {WITCH_NAME} chose pool for herself. The girl took her phone, changed the response from pool to reading in the library, sent it, and handed the phone back. The girl saw her anger.

During evening free time, {WITCH_NAME} asked the girl to meet alone in the reception room. Uneasy after their midday argument, the girl started an audio recording just before entering and kept the phone in her pocket. Later, a girl in the entrance hall saw {WITCH_NAME} leave the reception room alone. After stepping through the open doorway, {WITCH_NAME} raised her invisible wall across it. It blocked passage from either side and would remain until she dismissed it. The witness approached the doorway and struck a rigid surface she could not see. {WITCH_NAME} then went to the recreation room and stayed with other prisoners.

After the wall vanished, the witness entered the reception room. The girl lay dead inside with bruises around her neck, and the phone in her pocket was still recording. The uninterrupted audio contained only the victim's voice and {WITCH_NAME}'s. {WITCH_NAME} said that the girl would never choose for her again. A struggle followed; the girl's breathing became choked, then stopped. {WITCH_NAME}'s footsteps and the door opening came afterward. She claimed that the girl had been alive when she left and that the wall merely ended their argument. The recording showed that the girl stopped breathing before {WITCH_NAME}'s departure, while the neck bruises and the witness's account established that {WITCH_NAME} had strangled the girl by hand before leaving.
fields.epitaph: Her last boundary closed until no room remained.
execution: A clear rigid cylinder surrounds her from head to foot and begins to contract as she presses against it. Its wall closes over her shoulders, arms, and ribs. It keeps tightening, breaking her ribs and preventing her lungs from expanding, until her breathing and movement stop and she dies.

magic.name: Invisible Wall
magic.text: She can raise an invisible rigid wall across an opening.
